stem:
Vihan lists three cell jobs: letting useful materials in and wastes out while separating cells; housing many life processes; and regulating the cell’s activities and growth.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The cell membrane does the first job: it controls what enters and leaves and separates cells.
The cytoplasm does the second job: many life processes occur there.
The nucleus does the first job: it controls what enters and leaves and separates cells.
The cell membrane does the third job as well, because controlling materials in and out means it regulates growth.

teacher.key_rationale: Membrane handles exchange and separation; cytoplasm houses many life processes; the nucleus regulates activities and growth. Assigning membrane exchange to the nucleus, or saying exchange equals growth control, conflates those jobs.
